title: Private subnet
intro: Validators score miners in secret. Nobody can see or copy a score until every validator has locked theirs in. Then the scores are opened, and Yuma consensus pays the miners the majority agrees on. A validator who tries to boost a miner the others don't rate gets cut back to the consensus.
steps: The owner adds validators with their stake (Add validator).
Each validator picks themselves at the top right, types one score per miner (e.g. 4,3,2,1) plus a secret word, and copies the seal.
Lock in the seal. Once every validator has locked in, the reveal opens.
Each validator reveals the same scores and secret. Once everyone has revealed, anyone presses Run consensus.

constructor.help: How many miners, how long validators get to lock in and to reveal (seconds), and how much is paid out each round.

phase.label: Stage (0 lock in, 1 reveal, 2 ready to run)

seal.label: Make my seal
seal.help: Computed by the node, not sent on-chain. Keep your secret: you need it to reveal.

finalize.label: Run consensus
finalize.help: Pays miners and validators and starts the next round.

set_validator.label: Add validator / set stake
set_validator.help: Owner only. New validators can only join before anyone locks in this round.
